info.title: H1's API
info.description:
An API for interacting with the data provided by Ribbon Health, including information about healthcare providers,
locations, insurances, and more.

## Price Transparency v2

Location-first negotiated rate endpoints live under `/v2/*` (separate from legacy
`/v1/pricing/*`). Use them to:

1. Look up procedures, care clusters, and carriers (`GET /v2/procedures`,
   `/v2/care-clusters`, `/v2/carriers`)
2. Get prices for a known location (`GET /v2/locations/{location_id}/pricing/...`)
3. Shop by geography (`GET /v2/pricing/locations/...`)

**Key differences from v1:** prices are location-scoped (not provider-first);
carriers use string business ids (not v1 carrier UUIDs); every v2 response uses
the same envelope (`parameters`, `total_count`, `page`, `page_size`, `data`);
geo search requires an explicit `address` or `lat`+`lng` (no silent default).

See the **Price Transparency v2** tag for full endpoint reference.

tags.name: Price Transparency v2
tags.description:
Location-first negotiated rates under `/v2/*`. Prefer these endpoints for new
integrations. Carrier ids come from `GET /v2/carriers` and are not interchangeable
with v1 pricing carrier UUIDs. Provider-scoped v2 routes are not live yet.

get.description:
Browse or search the Price Transparency v2 procedure code dictionary.

Use this to resolve a CPT (or other) code before pricing lookups, or to
discover which care clusters a procedure belongs to. This endpoint does
**not** return dollar amounts.

#### Example Use Case
Look up CPT `27447` to confirm its description and see that it belongs to
the `JOINT_REPLACEMENT` care cluster before calling a pricing endpoint.

#### Notes
- Requires Price Transparency access (`doctors.can_price_transparency`).
- Rate limited to 1,000 requests per minute.
- All Price Transparency v2 endpoints share the same response envelope:
  `parameters`, `total_count`, `page`, `page_size`, and `data`.

parameters.name: procedure_code_scheme
parameters.description: Exact match on procedure coding system (for example `CPT` or `HCPCS`).

parameters.name: procedure_description
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring match on procedure description.

parameters.name: care_cluster_code
parameters.description: Filter to a specific care cluster by its business code (for example `JOINT_REPLACEMENT`).

parameters.name: care_cluster_description
parameters.description:
Match on care cluster display description. Case-insensitive substring on
dictionary endpoints; case-insensitive exact match on DB-backed pricing
endpoints; case-sensitive exact match on Elasticsearch search endpoints.

items.description: A procedure code from the Price Transparency v2 dictionary.

care_clusters.description: Present only when the procedure belongs to one or more care clusters.

403.description: The caller does not have Price Transparency access.

get.description:
Browse care cluster definitions and the procedures each cluster includes.

A care cluster is a curated group of related procedures that together
represent a care episode (for example joint replacement). Use this
dictionary before querying bundle prices.

#### Example Use Case
Search for clusters matching `"joint"` to find `JOINT_REPLACEMENT` and see
which CPT codes are expected in that bundle.

items.description: A care cluster definition from the Price Transparency v2 dictionary.

care_cluster_code.description: Stable business code for the cluster.

procedures.description: Member procedures that make up this care episode.

403.description: The caller does not have Price Transparency access.

get.description:
List carriers available in the Price Transparency v2 pricing data set.

Use this to discover valid `carrier_id` values for pricing filters.

#### Important
These identifiers are **not** the same as v1 [`/v1/pricing/carriers`](./getpricingcarriers)
UUIDs. Always resolve carriers through this endpoint (or a curated customer
mapping) when working with v2.

parameters.name: carrier_id
parameters.description: Exact match on carrier business id.

parameters.name: carrier_name
page
parameters.description: Page of results to return. Values below `1` are treated as `1`.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of results per page. Hard-capped at **100**.

allOf.description:
Standard response envelope for all Price Transparency v2 endpoints.
Pagination fields are always present; `parameters` echoes the non-null filters
that were applied (pagination keys are omitted from the echo).

parameters.description: Echo of non-null request filters (pagination omitted).

total_count.description: Total matching rows across all pages.

page_size.description: Page size used for this response.

items.description:
An insurance carrier in the Price Transparency v2 data set.
Use `carrier_id` as the filter value on pricing endpoints.

carrier_id.description: Business id used in all v2 pricing filters.

get.description:
Return all procedure-level negotiated rates for a single facility /
practice location, optionally filtered by carrier.

Results are ordered cheapest-first by `min`.

#### Example Use Case
Given location `1001` and carrier `78110`, list every procedure priced at
that site for that carrier, sorted from lowest to highest `min`.

#### Path parameter
`location_id` accepts either the integer location id **or** the location UUID.
Unknown values return HTTP 404.

#### Carrier filtering
Prefer `carrier_id` (from [`GET /v2/carriers`](./getv2carriers)).
`plan_id` is accepted in the contract but currently returns HTTP 501.
`carrier_id` and `plan_id` are mutually exclusive (HTTP 400 if both are sent).

parameters.name: location_id
parameters.description: The location to look up. Accepts either the integer location id **or** the location UUID.

200.description: Procedure price records for the location.

items.description: Location-scoped negotiated rate statistics for a single procedure and carrier.

care_cluster_codes.description: Present when the procedure belongs to one or more care clusters.

400.description: Invalid query parameters (for example both `carrier_id` and `plan_id`).

403.description: The caller does not have Price Transparency access.

404.description: The given location could not be found.

get.description:
Return care-cluster (bundle) prices for a single facility / practice
location, optionally filtered by carrier.

Results are ordered cheapest-first by `bundle_price`.

Each record includes completeness fields so clients can see how much of the
expected procedure set has pricing at that site:
`procedure_count`, `expected_procedure_count`, `completeness_pct`,
`included_procedures`, and `missing_procedures`.

#### Path parameter
`location_id` accepts either the integer location id **or** the location UUID.
Unknown values return HTTP 404.

#### Carrier filtering
Prefer `carrier_id`. `plan_id` currently returns HTTP 501.
`carrier_id` and `plan_id` are mutually exclusive.

200.description: Care cluster price records for the location.

items.description: Location-scoped care-cluster (bundle) price for a single carrier.

bundle_price.description: Aggregated price for the cluster at this location / carrier.

procedure_count.description: How many expected procedures in the cluster have pricing.

expected_procedure_count.description: How many procedures the cluster definition expects.

included_procedures.description: Procedures that contributed to the bundle. Defaults to `[]`.

missing_procedures.description: Expected procedures with no price at this location/carrier. Defaults to `[]`.

400.description: Invalid query parameters (for example both `carrier_id` and `plan_id`).

403.description: The caller does not have Price Transparency access.

404.description: The given location could not be found.

get.description:
Find **location-level** procedure prices near an address or lat/lng,
sorted by price ascending (`min`).

This is the primary “shop around me” endpoint for individual procedures.

#### Location required
Unlike v1 (which silently defaulted to a New York City address), v2 requires
either `address` **or** both `lat` and `lng`. Missing location → HTTP 400.
Providing only one of `lat`/`lng` → HTTP 400. Failed geocoding → HTTP 400.

#### Example Use Case
Search for CPT `27447` within 25 miles of ZIP `10001` for carrier `78110`,
sorted from lowest to highest negotiated `min`, with facility address fields
for a map UI.

#### Carrier filtering
Prefer `carrier_id`. `plan_id` currently returns HTTP 501.
`carrier_id` and `plan_id` are mutually exclusive.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description:
Free-text address or ZIP code, geocoded server-side.

Provide **either** `address` **or** both `lat` and `lng`. Failed geocoding returns HTTP 400.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description:
Latitude for a coordinate search. Must be provided together with `lng`.

Provide **either** both `lat` and `lng`, **or** `address`. Providing only one of
`lat`/`lng` returns HTTP 400.

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description:
Longitude for a coordinate search. Must be provided together with `lat`.

Provide **either** both `lat` and `lng`, **or** `address`. Providing only one of
`lat`/`lng` returns HTTP 400.

parameters.name: distance_miles
parameters.description: Search radius in miles from the resolved address or coordinates. Must be greater than zero.

parameters.name: carrier_id
parameters.description:
Filter results to a single insurance carrier using the v2 carrier business id
(for example `78110`).

Discover valid values with [`GET /v2/carriers`](./getv2carriers). These ids are
**not** the same as v1 `/v1/pricing/carriers` UUIDs.

Mutually exclusive with `plan_id` — sending both returns HTTP 400.

parameters.name: plan_id
parameters.description:
Reserved for filtering by a Ribbon insurance plan UUID.

**Not functional yet** — requests that include `plan_id` return HTTP 501 until
plan→carrier mapping is available. Prefer `carrier_id` today.

Mutually exclusive with `carrier_id` — sending both returns HTTP 400.

200.description: Location procedure price hits near the search point.

items.description:
Geographic search hit for a location-level procedure price. Sorted by `min`
ascending. Includes facility identity and geo fields for mapping UIs.

care_cluster_code.description: Present when the procedure is associated with a care cluster.

400.description:
Invalid search — missing location, incomplete lat/lng, failed geocode,
or mutually exclusive carrier filters.

403.description: The caller does not have Price Transparency access.

get.description:
Find **location-level** care-cluster (bundle) prices near an address or
lat/lng, sorted by `bundle_price` ascending.

Same geo / carrier / pagination rules as
[`GET /v2/pricing/locations/procedures`](./getv2pricinglocationprocedures).

Optional `procedure_code` filters to bundles whose `included_procedures`
contain that code.

#### Location required
Provide either `address` **or** both `lat` and `lng`. Missing location,
incomplete coordinates, or failed geocoding → HTTP 400.

200.description: Location care cluster price hits near the search point.

items.description:
Geographic search hit for a location-level care-cluster (bundle) price.
Sorted by `bundle_price` ascending.

400.description:
Invalid search — missing location, incomplete lat/lng, failed geocode,
or mutually exclusive carrier filters.

403.description: The caller does not have Price Transparency access.
